entry.title: Resolution 547 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAI‘I, HAWAI‘I HEALTH SYSTEMS CORPORATION, KA‘Ū HOSPITAL AND RURAL HEALTH CLINIC, FOR PRE-ORDERED LUNCHES

Allows for the receipt of pre-ordered lunches for senior citizens who are assisted by the County’s nutritional services and programs.
